title: Zuckerberg Bets on Personal AI Agents: Meta Aims to Bring Billions of Users into the Agent Era

content_html:
Mark Zuckerberg, founder and CEO of Meta, stated during the company's latest quarterly earnings call that billions of people will have AI agents capable of understanding personal goals and assisting with tasks around the clock within the next five years. Meta is building its strategy around personal AI agents, instant messaging platforms, and AI infrastructure, aiming to position AI agents as a key product and source of revenue growth for the next phase.

Zuckerberg believes that in the future, people will use AI agents to handle complex matters such as finance, health, relationships, and family management. He said that as the era of interacting with multiple AI agents emerges, the importance of instant messaging platforms like WhatsApp will further increase. Currently, WhatsApp has become the main entry point for users to access Meta's AI services.

Meta is not the only tech company betting on the agent direction. Google is upgrading its search experience, making custom AI agents one of its core features; Claude Code, an AI coding assistant from Anthropic, has also seen rapid growth due to developer popularity. Industry competition is shifting from traditional chatbots to AI Agent systems capable of performing tasks and acting on behalf of users.

However, Meta's large-scale investment in AI has raised concerns among investors. After releasing its financial results, the company's stock dropped nearly 10%. The company's Reality Labs division lost about $4.6 billion this quarter, bringing cumulative losses since 2021 to approximately $88 billion, mainly invested in AR glasses, VR headsets, and related software ecosystems.

Meanwhile, Meta's investment in AI infrastructure continues to grow. This quarter, the company's free cash flow was only $784 million, down about 91% compared to $8.55 billion in the same period last year. This week, Meta announced a partnership with BlackRock, investing about $1.4 billion to build a data center in El Paso, Texas, to support future AI computing needs.

Zuckerberg stated that while there are opportunities to sell AI computing power, compared to directly providing computing power, AI products and intelligent services still offer higher profit potential. He expects personal AI agents to be a core product direction for the coming months and years.

content_html_zh:
Meta 创始人兼首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在公司最新的季度财报电话会议上表示，未来五年内，数十亿人将拥有能够理解个人目标并全天候协助完成任务的人工智能代理。 Meta正在围绕个人人工智能代理、即时通讯平台和人工智能基础设施制定战略，旨在将人工智能代理定位为下一阶段的关键产品和收入增长来源。

扎克伯格认为，未来，人们将使用人工智能代理来处理财务、健康、人际关系、家庭管理等复杂事务。 他表示，随着与多个AI代理交互的时代的出现，WhatsApp等即时通讯平台的重要性将进一步增加。 目前，WhatsApp已成为用户访问Meta AI服务的主要入口。

Meta并不是唯一一家押注代理方向的科技公司。 谷歌正在升级其搜索体验，使定制人工智能代理成为其核心功能之一； Anthropic 的人工智能编码助手 Claude Code 也因开发者的受欢迎而实现了快速增长。 行业竞争正在从传统的聊天机器人转向能够执行任务并代表用户行事的人工智能代理系统。

不过，Meta对AI的大规模投资引发了投资者的担忧。 公布财报后，该公司股价下跌近10%。 该公司的Reality Labs部门本季度亏损约46亿美元，使2021年以来的累计亏损达到约880亿美元，主要投资于AR眼镜、VR耳机和相关软​​件生态系统。

与此同时，Meta对人工智能基础设施的投资持续增长。 本季度，该公司的自由现金流仅为7.84亿美元，较去年同期的85.5亿美元下降约91%。 本周，Meta 宣布与贝莱德建立合作伙伴关系，投资约 14 亿美元在德克萨斯州埃尔帕索建设数据中心，以支持未来的 AI 计算需求。

扎克伯格表示，虽然存在出售AI算力的机会，但与直接提供算力相比，AI产品和智能服务仍然具有更高的盈利潜力。 他预计个人人工智能代理将成为未来几个月和几年的核心产品方向。
